skipped.message: checkpoint-1 predates three product laws the flow now hits: (1) the staged-approval completion gate (signal_done refuses while high-impact staged changes are unapplied - the engine's run creates them), (2) I-09 verification-first default-on (a done-signal needs the run's own recorded green test), and (3) reviewer integrity (unknown/absent test evidence is never a pass). A faithful redesign must approve+apply the staged changes through the collab path and record real green evidence before signalling; patching the old happy path would fabricate a pass the product refuses. Tracked in week-04 ledger §7 for the owner/next lane.
